messages.subject: Reason(s) for "Disconnected from server"
parts:
Hello all,

I have a Shiny app - available under https://owid.shinyapps.io/WortschatzZeit/ - that disconnects quite often. It doesn't happen when I test in on the local desktop. Here is what I checked:

Browser console: There is actually a message saying that it disconnected:
Sat Oct 01 2016 15:11:14 GMT+0200 (CEST): Connection closed. Info: {"type":"close","code":1000,"reason":"Normal closure","wasClean":true}

But "normal closure" does not help me very much.

I am on a starter plan with shinyapps.io and checked if the app uses too much memory. However, memory usage peaks at 300 MB, which should be fine. Also, the log (using showLogs() does not contain any information about errors or warnings. The disconnect is reproducible if you type 1 into the first numericInput widget (labelled "Mindestfrequenz im Ausgangsjahr").

Any help is much appreciated, thank you!

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Reason(s) for "Disconnected from server"
parts: You are hitting 1GB at times which is the limit for the large instance type, and the application is then terminated.

messages.subject: Re: Reason(s) for "Disconnected from server"
parts:
Joshua, thanks a lot for your reply! Just as a quick follow-up to that:

I think I found a workaround to assess memory usage of a Shiny app: When running the app locally on my desktop (Mac), I can look up the memory usage of the rsession that is spawned by Shiny (that should be possible for all OSes). There, I indeed saw that certain parameters set in the app lead to memory usage of this spawned rsession above 1 GB.

But just to be sure: There is no way to assess this on shinyapps.io itself, or is there?
